item.title: Frequency Spreading
item.description:
One of the most infuriating things about modern PCs, barring RGB, is the harmonic resonance of fans. That continually amplified jet engine sound while you're trying to think. It's been my mission for a while to free myself from this. I finally think I've found an ample solution, or rather taken on one from the 2019 Mac Pro 7,1. That is frequency spreading, which is technically just resonance avoidance via RPM offset. Notes
